name: cavemio-sparkline
title: Sparkline
description: An ultra-compact inline trendline with magnetic scrubber and auto-trend color for table cells and stat cards.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Uses ResizeObserver to continuously measure parent container width, re-projecting curves without layout thrashing.
- Scrubber calculations use pure relative coordinate offsets and render tooltips within absolute coordinates.
- Auto-trend color evaluation respects shadcn dark mode with explicit dark: variant tokens.
- Screen readers receive an accessible summary with starting value, ending value, and directional trend description.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: data
props.type: (number | { value: number; date?: string; label?: string })[]
props.description: – · Array of data points or point objects with value and date.

props.name: width
props.description: "100%" · Component width (can be percentage or pixel number).

props.name: color
props.description: "auto" · Color scheme: auto (green/red based on trend), primary, or custom class.

props.name: variant
props.description: "area" · Visual rendering style: line, area gradient, or bars.

props.name: showScrubber
props.description: true · Enables magnetic hover scrubber and micro-tooltip.

props.name: showLastPoint
props.description: true · Displays persistent anchor dot on the latest data point.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: 1.35 · thin line stroke width in pixels.

props.name: label
props.description: "Metric trend" · Accessible label for assistive tech.

useCases.title: Data table rows
useCases.description: Show 30-day activity, revenue, or usage trends directly inside table cells.

useCases.title: Stat & metric cards
useCases.description: Sit beside a prominent KPI number to provide immediate historical context.

useCases.title: Financial watchlists
useCases.description: Compact stock, crypto, or commodity price tickers with green/red directional indicators.

useCases.title: Server & CPU monitors
useCases.description: Display live CPU load, memory usage, or ping latency across a grid of instances.

features.title: Zero layout shift
features.description: Renders cleanly within table cells and flex rows without shifting surrounding cell boundaries or altering line heights.

features.title: Smooth cubic curves
features.description: Generates tangent-continuous cubic bezier curves rather than harsh jagged polylines.

features.title: Magnetic scrubber
features.description: Tracks mouse or touch coordinates and snaps to the nearest discrete data point with a guide line and snapped dot.

features.title: Floating micro-tooltip
features.description: Shows the exact value and optional date timestamp directly above the active point, constrained within viewport bounds.

features.title: Dynamic auto-trend
features.description: Automatically detects whether the final point is higher than the initial point, applying emerald or rose tokens accordingly.

features.title: Multiple visual styles
features.description: Switches seamlessly between smooth line, area gradient fill, and discrete vertical bars.

states.title: rest
states.description: Clean thin line SVG curve with an optional subtle gradient fill. A subtle dot anchors the latest data point.

states.title: hover / scrub
states.description: Pointer movement snaps to the nearest data point, rendering a dashed vertical guide and a micro-tooltip with exact values.

states.title: positive trend
states.description: When the last point is greater than or equal to the first, applies theme emerald tokens.

states.title: negative trend
states.description: When the last point dips below the first, applies theme rose tokens.

states.title: bars
states.description: Renders discrete rounded vertical bars with proportional opacity highlighting hovered columns.
